tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las bzhugs:

rgya gar skad du: shrī ma hā kā la dzñā na sarba duṣ+ṭān: karma nā ma: bod skad du: dpal ldan mgon po bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las: bcom ldan 'das zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000270 rang nyid skad cig gis yongs rdzogs he ru ka gsal ba'i mdun du mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa char sprin gtibs pa ltar byon nas: phrin las gang bcol skad cig nyid la sgrub par 1$0000300 bsam nas: ai: chos sku skye med nam mkha' lta bu la: snying rje chen po sems can kun la khyab: rgyu las kun bskyed yi ge hūm̐ du shar: hūm̐ las 'od 'phros 'byung ba rim brtsegs bskyed: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐ hūm̐: e las nam mkha' mthing nag yangs pa'i klong: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor g.yo bar byed: ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs: suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi brdal bar chags: keṃ las keng rus ri rab lhun sdug brjid: raṃ las bskal pa'i me phung 'khrug cing 'bar: de steng bh+rūm̐ las drag po'i gzhal yas khang: rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i pho brang gsal: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe bhan+dha dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: ru tra kro ti ti ra baṃ: pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal bh+rūm̐: hūm̐: drag po'i pho brang dbus kyi lte ba la: ru dra dgra bgegs pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: hūm̐ las me 'od rdo rje'i tsha tsha 'phro: gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad nas: tshur 'dus dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing rngam pa'i zhal: phyag g.yas be con rdo rje lcags phur bsgril: phyag g.yon bhan+dha rak+ṣa'i phreng ba dang: dbyug tho phyar zhing dgra snying sbrul zhags 'dzin: dar nag ber gsol rin chen gser sked bcings: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du mdzes: che ba'i yon tan thams cad sku la rdzogs: de yi g.yas su g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i steng:

mthing nag e las drag po'i skur bzhengs pa: srid gsum sgrol mdzad rak+sha mthu bo che: chos nyid mi 'gyur sku mdog mthing nag rngam: zhal bzhi phyag bzhi 'jigs pa'i cha lugs can: g.yas gnyis be con dang ni rgyal mtshan 'dzin: g.yon gnyis gser gyi ral gri zhags pa bsnams: gtso bo'i g.yon du lcags kyi drel rta'i steng: bh+yo las ye shes dbyings kyi ma mo ni: smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus zhal smug nag brjid: phyag g.yas rdo rje zhing chung ral gri phyar: phyag g.yon bhan+dha ne'u le tri shul 'dzin: dur khrod chas brgyad sku la legs par brgyan: de yi phyi rim gru chad bar khyams la: sku sprul stag zhon gsung sprul bing chen dang: thugs sprul gri gug yon tan seng zhon dang: phrin las sprul pa trag shad nag po dang: lha mo sde lnga 'khor dang bcas pa dang: las mgon bya rog gdong dang seng ge'i gdong: gshin rje chos rgyal so ka rā tsa dang: sprul pa mched gsum bshan pa dmar nag dang: gtsang rigs dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang: sngags bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang: sgo bzhi srung mdzad rgyal chen sde bzhi dang: phyi 'khor skyong ba bod khams brtan ma'i tshogs: sprul 'khor dam can bsam gyis mi khyab pa: bstan srung yongs rdzogs mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs: oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdza: hūm̐: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: dpal chen dngos sprul ye shes mgon po'i sku: snang srid 'khor 'das yongs la dbang sgyur phyir: mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdza: hūm̐ bh+yo: dad pa dang ni dam tshig tshul bzhin du: tshur gshegs tshur byon bstan srung yongs rdzogs lha: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir spyan 'dren no: rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: oṃ ma hā kā la sarba duṣ+ṭān sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥdza:

hūm̐: dur khrod rab 'jigs gzhal yas dam pa 'dir: dgra bgegs pad+ma nyi zla brdzis pa'i steng: bstan srung yongs rdzogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: rang rang rten bzhugs mchod bzhes phrin las mdzod: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: skyes pa'i tshul gyi bstan srung yongs rdzogs lha: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i mthu rtsal can: yongs rdzogs 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: hūm̐: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: mchod yon me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul: bdud rtsi sman dang rak+ta ba liṃ rgyan: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus pa dang: nang khrol glo snying mkhal mar bcas la sogs: rngams pa'i zhal du mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol: ma hā sarba pū dza khā hi: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga na gu ti yo gī shwa rī sa ma ya hūm̐ dzaḥdza: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: e ma hoḥngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos: chos sku skye med kun tu bzang po'i sku: longs sku 'gag med che mchog he ru ka: sprul sku dpal ldan ye shes mgon po'i sku: sku gsum dbyer med khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: bh+yo: yum chen ye shes dbyings kyi ma mo ni: rang don grub nas gzhan don rdzogs pa'i dpal: thabs mkhas thugs rje don gnyis mthar phyin ma: dpal ldan lha mo khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ai: phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba'i dbang dang ldan: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa: tshangs pa lha yi phrin las mi g.yo ba: lha chen dpal 'bar khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: sku sprul stag zhon gsung sprul bing chen dang: thugs sprul gri gug yon tan seng zhon dang:

phrin las sprul pa trag shad nag po ste: mgon po sde lnga 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod: dpal ldan 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma: lha mo re ti gshin rje re ti dang: rak+sha re ti gnod sbyin re ti ste: lha mo sde lnga 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod: las mgon bya rog gdong dang seng ge'i gdong: gshin rje chos rgyal so ka rā tsa dang: sprul pa mched gsum bshan pa dmar nag dang: gtsang rigs dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga dang: sngags bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang: sgo bzhi srung mdzad rgyal chen sde bzhi dang: phyi rol skyong ba bod khams brtan ma'i tshogs: sprul 'khor dam can bsam gyis mi khyab pa: bstan srung yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dir gshegs mchod bzhes dam bskang phrin las mdzod: chos skyong bstan srung yongs rdzogs kyi phrin las rdzogs so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
